id_reservations.note: Flow ids are the name-derived ids we expect (name with underscores + _A00); the platform assigns the real ids, read back after generate. List ids carry NO _A00 suffix so display names stay clean (A2 L35). Role ids are stable IR slugs; live role _ids are read back. Step ids are prefixed per flow (CASE_, OPNT_, CHRQ_) so they can't collide with field ids such as OP_Key or CR_Key.

CIQ_Case_A00.lane_prefix: <D>_ for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS, RMM
CIQ_Case_A00.rule: v4 names first (L197-L206, L189, L191), then PART D L733-L782 where it agrees with v4. Material fields are plain Text on the case (no CIQ Raw Material, L132). Contacts are fields, never a child table (L330). Gate and hold counts are plain Number fields written by the acting person's Workbench (A2 L32-L33, e.g. Open_Items_Count, Open_CR_Count, <D>_Open_Count, <D>_RMES_Gaps) read by blank-safe formulas; no aggregates. The step-condition fields above are reserved.

CIQ_Open_Point_A00.rule: v4 L244-L251, then PART D L887-L912 where it agrees (one item per point, not per round). Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Rounds columns use the Rounds_ prefix (A2 L31).

CIQ_Change_Request_A00.prefix: CR_ for identity and outcome; Impact_<D> and <D>_ assessment fields for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS
CIQ_Change_Request_A00.rule: v4 L267-L272, then PART D L957-L966. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Y6 fills the case keys it has (Case_Code, Cycle_No); RMM sets Case_Item_Id at Triage.

hard_rules.rule: Exactly 11 flows (Processes CIQ Case, CIQ Open Point, CIQ Change Request; Forms CIQ Supplier, CIQ Config Version, CIQ Section, CIQ Scope Run, CIQ RMES Safety, CIQ RMES Regulatory, CIQ Internal Note, CIQ Audit Event), 7 embedded child tables, 2 native References (ER01, ER02), 22 lists, 11 custom roles plus Admin and User reused. No portal (CIQP) flow, no 'CIQ ZZ Spike' flow, no CIQ Raw Material / Case Contact / Supplier Contact / Component / Config Release / per-round / Item Register flow. Every flow and list name starts with 'CIQ '.

Step ids, names, kinds, owners and conditions exactly as id_reservations.step_prefix_by_flow, byte-exact with the en-dash U+2013. First and last steps unconditioned. 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review' is one Parallel step with six single-step branches; 'Assess impact' is one Parallel step with five. The six Open Point review steps are sequential conditional steps (exactly one runs), not a parallel block. No explicit Reject/Cancel steps (native reject and send-back, LESSONS 13). Every human step carries an SLA; durations are set by BDF after generate. No step is assigned to CIQ Integration Service after Start.

Field names per id_reservations.field_prefix_by_flow and global_field_rules. Native References only ER01 and ER02 (Result_Case on both RMES Forms); every other link is a Text key (text_key_links) and must NOT become a Reference. Child tables use the reserved child_table_ids and display names; columns use the column_id_prefix. Author the 22 lists with the reserved list ids (no _A00) and items. The reserved step-condition fields (Dept_<D>_Active, OP_To_Supplier, OP_Dept, Impact_<D>, Overall_Approval_Required, Overall_Decision, Hold_For_Open_Items) must exist with values that match the conditions.

Initiators: CIQ Case = CIQ RMM; CIQ Open Point = CIQ RMM and the five Reviewer roles; CIQ Change Request = CIQ Integration Service and CIQ RMM. Name the trade-off that Editable on a Process grants InitiateItems (A2 L56; LESSONS 18). CIQ RMES Safety editable by CIQ Safety Reviewer only, CIQ RMES Regulatory by CIQ Regulatory Reviewer only. Child-table step permissions by table key only. Flow Admin for CIQ Case Admin and no-Delete members are post-generate items. Every role in journey_flow_map must be able to read each flow on its path.

content.summary: CIQ Digital (CIQ_Digital_A00) is the internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire. RMM creates a case for a supplier raw material, receives basic data from the supplier (portal), runs the scope rules and releases sections, obtains the PS-05 completeness confirmation, then the active departments (Regulatory, Safety, QM, Microbiology, Sustainability, optionally RMM) review in parallel, raising open points with the supplier and (Safety, Regulatory) filling one RMES sheet each. Open-items checks and an optional overall approval precede the single PS-11 final release; the end produces a PDF. Supplier change requests are triaged by RMM and assessed in parallel. v4 model: 11 flows (3 Processes, 8 Data Forms) with child tables Contacts, Components, Criteria, Findings, Rounds; 11 custom roles plus Admin/User; the supplier acts only in the separate portal. PART A rules bind: no aggregates (Number count fields + blank-safe formulas), no pages, exact step names, intra-app automations Z1–Z4 only.

personas.name: Raw Material Manager (RMM)
personas.description: Owns the CIQ case end to end and is the single intermediary between the Beiersdorf departments and the supplier. Creates the case, holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and every check, runs scope check, triages change requests, maintains suppliers and contacts, and owns the optional RMM review branch (off by default).
goals: Create a case with all mandatory material, supplier, contact, owner and due-date data
Release the right scope (one section per Mandatory/Optional section, extend never reduce) and activate the right departments
Move the case through basic data, completeness PS-05, Part 2 review, optional overall approval and the single final release PS-11
Resolve leftovers at the two open-items checks, or override with an audited reason
Triage supplier change requests and refuse attempts after the final release
Cancel a case cleanly so no supplier task is left open; complete manually with a reason when needed
Keep supplier companies and their contacts (portal user ids) correct
pain_points: Kissflow has no field-change trigger, so supplier answer changes must arrive as change notices
Nobody may write the case during Part 2, so contact changes need their own open point
Native aggregates are unreliable, so gates depend on count fields written by the acting person

journeys.name: Create a CIQ case
journeys.trigger: RMM decides to qualify a supplier raw material (a new case cycle)
steps: Enter the material (trade name, main INCI, BDF, SAP and IRMA numbers) as plain case fields
Pick the supplier from CIQ Supplier and set the case contacts (contact list for display, portal contact ids, confirm contact ids, supplier contact e-mails)
Set owner and due dates
The pinned Release row (id, hash, manifest copy) is copied into the case
Submit; only after the submit succeeds the BASIC CIQ Section row is created (which creates the portal section)
journeys.outcome: A case at 'Waiting for supplier: basic data' with a pinned release and a BASIC section released to the portal
success_criteria: Missing mandatory data blocks creation
Contacts are fields on the case, never a child table
Exactly one BASIC section row per case
journeys.evidence: brd.md L184; brd.md L197-L199; brd.md L330; brd.md L335

journeys.name: Receive the supplier's basic data
journeys.trigger: The case enters 'Waiting for supplier: basic data'
steps: X1 creates the CIQP Request in the portal
The supplier submits basic data in the portal
Y1 sets 'basic data received' and the portal request id, and the step is approved
Fallback: RMM checks the portal and submits the step by hand
journeys.outcome: Case moves to Scope check
success_criteria: Supplier due date drives the step SLA and escalates to the owner
journeys.evidence: brd.md L185; brd.md L291; brd.md L296; brd.md L782

journeys.name: Scope check and section release
journeys.trigger: Basic data received (case at 'Scope check')
steps: Check BASIC answers (read through flow sharing); if incomplete, raise a query and wait
Run the scope rules into a CIQ Scope Run (every section incl. N.A., with rule and answer)
Optionally extend the scope with a justification (never reduce)
Release one CIQ Section row per Mandatory or Optional section (X2 creates each portal section)
Set which departments are active (Dept_<D>_Active) and the RMES key
journeys.outcome: Scope recorded, sections with the supplier, departments for Part 2 fixed; case moves to completeness PS-05
journeys.frequency: once per case (plus later runs for extensions, change notices, additional parts)
success_criteria: Additions only
N.A. sections get no section row but stay in the scope run with their rule
Scope-check SLA
journeys.evidence: brd.md L186; brd.md L280-L281; brd.md L783

journeys.name: Obtain the completeness confirmation (PS-05)
journeys.trigger: Case enters 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05'
steps: X4 creates the CIQP Completeness Confirmation
The supplier confirms (name, e-mail, role, time)
Y4 records the confirmation and RMES_Created_At (RMES header) and approves
journeys.outcome: Questionnaire confirmed complete (data stays editable); exactly one RMES record header per case; Part 2 starts
success_criteria: Supplier due-date SLA
Completeness confirmation is not the final release
journeys.evidence: brd.md L187; brd.md L203; brd.md L294; brd.md L298; brd.md L560

journeys.name: Department review and sign-off in Part 2
journeys.trigger: The parallel block 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review' starts; each active department's branch opens (RMM branch off by default)
steps: Review the sections the department leads
Raise open points to the supplier or internally as needed
Safety and Regulatory fill their RMES sheet (see j06)
Workbench writes the department's open-item counts at its own step
Sign off only the own lane fields: confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of (SAF/REG also internal RMES decision and reason)
Delegation recorded via on-behalf-of and an audit event
journeys.outcome: Every active department's branch is done; native join moves the case on
journeys.frequency: once per active department per case
success_criteria: Submit blocked while the department has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings
Inactive department branches are skipped
Review SLA with reminder and escalation (REQ-RMES-019)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L188-L189; brd.md L201; brd.md L208-L212; brd.md L825

journeys.name: Fill the RMES sheet (Safety / Regulatory)
journeys.trigger: First Safety (resp. Regulatory) session after PS-05
steps: Create the department's single RMES row for the case, keyed by the case's RMES_Key, with a reference to the case
Take the edit lock (Editing_By / Editing_Since)
Record each criterion: applicability, source, prefill, result, comment, limit check, impact resolution, AI suggestion and who confirmed it
Record findings (text, criterion, blocking, state, linked open point)
Lift header counts (open criteria, open blocking findings) for the case gate
Record the internal RMES decision on the case lane
journeys.outcome: A complete RMES sheet per department per case whose counts allow the lane sign-off
journeys.frequency: once per case per department (plus re-assessments)
success_criteria: Only one Safety (resp. Regulatory) user writes at a time
Regulatory can read Safety but not edit it, and vice versa
journeys.evidence: brd.md L282-L283; brd.md L331; brd.md L376; brd.md L433

journeys.name: Clarify with the supplier through an open point
journeys.trigger: A department (or RMM at Scope check) needs a query answered, a document, or an additional part
steps: Raise the point: kind, owner department, to-supplier yes, reference (section, field, row or document by file name and upload date), question, supplier-facing justification, responsible person, internal and supplier due dates
Additional part: RMM or the sync service creates its CIQ Section row
X3 creates the portal query for the current round
Supplier responds; Y3 copies the answer, sets Awaiting_Response = No and approves
The owning department reviews: Accepted (records the accepted document), Withdrawn (with reason), or Return (round appended to Rounds, next question written, item sent back to 'Waiting for supplier')
journeys.outcome: The point is closed (Accepted or Withdrawn) with its full round history in one item
journeys.frequency: many per case, mainly in Part 2
success_criteria: Every open point blocks its department's sign-off and the release request until closed
Only the owning department reviews the answer
Responsible person and due dates are required
journeys.evidence: brd.md L224-L229; brd.md L236-L246; brd.md L249-L251

journeys.name: Handle late and internal work through internal open points
journeys.trigger: A department is activated after the fork, a completed department's basis changed, contacts must change after PS-05, or a co-review is wanted
steps: Raise an internal open point (Department review / Contact update / Internal review); the supplier step is skipped
The owning department reviews and closes it
Its accepted outcome counts as the department's completion for that scope
journeys.outcome: Late work has a task with an owner, and the holds count it
success_criteria: No one writes the case during Part 2; contact changes go through a Contact update point
journeys.evidence: brd.md L231-L234; brd.md L210; brd.md L424; brd.md L426

journeys.name: Clear leftovers at the open-items checks
journeys.trigger: After the Part 2 join (before release request) or after the final release step (before close), something is still open or a count is blank
steps: Resolve late department reviews and contact updates
Copy late completions
Or override with a reason, which is audited
journeys.outcome: Nothing open blocks the release request or the close
success_criteria: A blank count holds; the gate never deadlocks
Normal path stays automatic
journeys.evidence: brd.md L190; brd.md L193; brd.md L32-L34

journeys.name: Overall approval
journeys.trigger: Case reaches 'Overall approval' and Overall_Approval_Required = Yes
steps: Check every required RMES decision
Approve, or reject with a neutral closing text
journeys.outcome: Approved: the release request goes out. Rejected: the case ends without a release request and the close sweep runs
journeys.frequency: per case when switched on (off by default)
success_criteria: Approve only if every required RMES decision is Approved
Comes before the PS-11 release request
journeys.evidence: brd.md L191; brd.md L63; brd.md L220

journeys.name: Final release (PS-11) and close
journeys.trigger: Case enters 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11' (not overall-rejected)
steps: X5 sends the single release request
Supplier releases; Y5 records the release (released revisions, evidence list) and approves
Or RMM completes manually with a reason
Open items check before close if something opened during this step
End: Z1 produces the PDF, e-mails the RMM owner and the supplier contacts, logs the notification
journeys.outcome: Case completed with a final PDF; nothing editable by the supplier afterwards
success_criteria: Exactly one release request per case (REQ-PROC-040)
Manual completion carries a reason (REQ-PROC-045)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L192-L194; brd.md L301; brd.md L62

journeys.name: Cancel a case
journeys.trigger: The case must stop before completion
steps: RMM rejects at its own steps; in Part 2 the Case Admin rejects through the admin route
A Cancellation audit event is written
The case's open open points and change requests are ended
The close sweep snapshots and withdraws every open portal item
Z2 sends a neutral e-mail to the supplier
journeys.outcome: Case cancelled with no supplier task left open (REQ-PROC-049)
success_criteria: Same sweep after an overall rejection or a manual completion
journeys.evidence: brd.md L214-L220; brd.md L38; brd.md L413

journeys.name: Handle a supplier change request
journeys.trigger: Supplier submits a change request or change notice in the portal (Y6 creates the app item; RMM by hand as fallback)
steps: Triage: check the requester is a contact of the case
After PS-11: refuse and write a 'change attempt' audit event
Change notice: new scope run (additions only); new sections become section rows; a Department-review point for each new section's lead department
Set impact flags per department and the supplier-safe outcome text
Affected departments assess in parallel ('Assess – <dept>'), each writing only its own four fields; re-assessment goes into the RMES sheet
End: X6 sends the CIQP Notice with the outcome
journeys.outcome: Scope re-derived, affected departments informed and assessed, supplier notified
journeys.frequency: whenever a supplier changes configuration/metadata answers or asks for a correction
success_criteria: Every configuration answer change re-derives the scope (REQ-CFG-008, REQ-PROC-007)
Attempts after release refused and logged (REQ-PROC-043)
Affected departments informed (REQ-PROC-031)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L255-L272; brd.md L295; brd.md L299

journeys.name: Maintain suppliers and their contacts
journeys.trigger: A new supplier or contact is needed for a case, or contact data changes
steps: Create or update the supplier (code, legal name, DUNS, kind, country, SAP and Teamcenter ids, active, test)
Add contacts as rows: name, e-mail, role, may confirm, portal user id, active, invite requested/invited
Write rows one at a time, re-read and merge
Keep the parent mirrors (contact portal ids for search, pending invites count)
journeys.outcome: Every contact on a case has a portal user id; suppliers are searchable
success_criteria: One portal user serving two suppliers gets a row under each
Supplier_Code is the isolation key on every portal item
journeys.evidence: brd.md L278; brd.md L329

journeys.name: Author and publish configuration
journeys.trigger: Business wants to change templates, section definitions, rules, ownership, RMES criteria, limits, texts, reminders or settings
steps: Write a new config version row per kind (copy-on-write; never edit a published row)
Publish a Release row with the full bundle and its hash
Each publish writes an audit event
Download any version
journeys.outcome: New cases pin the new release; pinned releases never change
success_criteria: No four-eyes (A3)
No delete for the writer (K-17)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L279; brd.md L65; brd.md L375

journeys.name: Discuss a case internally
journeys.trigger: Any internal user wants to comment on a case, section, open point or finding
steps: Post one message (case, optional link, text, author, department, time)
Author edits only their own messages, by convention
journeys.outcome: Internal discussion attached to the case, never visible to suppliers (REQ-PROC-020)
success_criteria: Never shared with the portal

journeys.name: Inspect who did what and when
journeys.trigger: Audit, legal, customs or process-owner inquiry
steps: Read the audit events of a case or of configuration: who, what, when, old and new value, document by file name and upload date
Includes notifications, delegations, assignments, section-review marks, scope, configuration, change attempts, cancellations, snapshots, item created

journeys.name: Keep app and portal consistent (sync service)
journeys.trigger: Case cancelled, overall-rejected, manually completed, completed, or portal answers changed; X2/X3 fallback needed
steps: Close sweep: snapshot and withdraw every open portal item
Render the final PDF (option A)
Rebuild K2.1 Components
Create portal items as fallback for X2/X3
Write audit events

success_criteria: Never acts on a human step after Start

journeys.name: Supplier work in the portal (outside this app)

steps: Submit basic data, fill sections, respond to queries, confirm completeness, give the final release, raise change requests, acknowledge notices — all in CIQ_Supplier_Portal_A00
journeys.outcome: Supplier actions return to the app through Y1, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6

entities.name: CIQ Case
entities.description: One CIQ case cycle from creation to the final PDF: supplier hand-offs, scope check, parallel department review, optional overall approval, final release. Holds the RMES header, the case contacts as fields and the PS-05/PS-11 confirmations.
key_attributes: Identity: case code, cycle number
Material: Trade_Name, Main_INCI, BDF_Material_No (plain text, X1 reads them), SAP number, IRMA number
Supplier code and name
Owner (RMM) and due dates
Pinned release: row id, hash, manifest copy
Contacts: Case_Contacts_JSON, Portal_Contact_Ids, Confirm_Contact_Ids, Supplier_Contact_Emails (mandatory at Start)
Department active flags (REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS, RMM)
Six lanes: confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of; SAF and REG also internal RMES decision and reason
PS-05 and PS-11 request and confirmation fields
RMES header: RMES_Key, RMES_Created_At
Late completions
Holds and gates: blank-safe Number count fields (e.g. Open_Items_Count, Open_CR_Count, <D>_Open_Count, <D>_RMES_Gaps) read by formulas
Overall approval switch and decision
Outcome: completion trigger, supplier closing text, final PDF
lifecycle: Open items check – before release request (conditional)
Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11 (skipped if overall-rejected)
relationships: A Case belongs to one Supplier
A Case pins one Release row of CIQ Config Version
A Case has many Sections
A Case has 1-4 Scope Runs
A Case has many Open Points and Change Requests
A Case has at most one RMES Safety row and one RMES Regulatory row
A Case has many Internal Notes and Audit Events
A Case is the app twin of CIQP Request and feeds CIQP Completeness Confirmation and CIQP Final Release
entities.evidence: brd.md L119; brd.md L154-L220; brd.md L32-L33

entities.name: CIQ Open Point
entities.description: One question, document request or additional part to the supplier, with every back-and-forth round inside the same item; also the internal kinds Department review, Contact update and Internal review.
key_attributes: Case link, kind, owner department (OP_Dept), raised-by department, to-supplier yes/no
Reference: section, field, row, or document by file name and upload date

Current round as plain fields: key, round number, question, supplier-facing justification, due dates (internal and supplier), responsible person and department, reference, Portal_Contact_Ids, Thread_Text
Supplier response: kind, text, referenced documents; Awaiting_Response guard
Outcome: Accepted (accepted document), Withdrawn (reason), Return
Rounds child table: question, answer, outcome, reason, document, by, at
lifecycle: Waiting for supplier (only if to-supplier = Yes)
Return → back to Waiting for supplier with next round
relationships: An Open Point belongs to one Case
An Open Point references one Section (or document)
An Open Point has many Rounds
An additional-part Open Point causes one new Section
A Finding may link to an Open Point
Each round has one CIQP Query twin in the portal
entities.evidence: brd.md L120; brd.md L222-L251; brd.md L327-L328

entities.name: CIQ Change Request
entities.description: A change the supplier reports or requests: change notice, correction, or an attempt after release. RMM triages, affected departments assess in parallel, the supplier gets the outcome as a portal notice.
key_attributes: From the portal: CR key, case code, cycle, supplier code, change kind, section/field/row, current value, proposed value, change reason, portal item id, raised by
Triage: case link, contact verified, outcome, triage note, scope run key, impact flag per department (REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS), supplier-safe outcome text, notice key and title
Per department: assessment, note, assessed by, assessed at (four fields)
lifecycle: Assess impact (parallel: Assess – Regulatory/Safety/QM/Microbiology/Sustainability, each only if impacted)
relationships: A Change Request belongs to one Case
A change notice causes one Scope Run and possibly new Sections and Department-review Open Points
Twin of CIQP Change Request (in) and CIQP Notice (out)
entities.evidence: brd.md L121; brd.md L253-L272; brd.md L957-L966

entities.name: CIQ Supplier
entities.description: One supplier company with its people.
key_attributes: Supplier_Code (isolation key on every portal item)
Legal name, DUNS, supplier kind, supplier country, SAP id, Teamcenter id, active, test
Parent mirrors: Contact_Portal_Ids_Text (search), Pending_Invites (count)
Contacts child table: name, e-mail, contact role, may confirm, portal user id, active, invite requested, invited
relationships: A Supplier has many Contacts

Payload; content hash
Release rows: Release_Bundle_JSON plus hash, release stage (Test/Live), change summary
Published by, published at

Many Cases pin one Release row

entities.name: CIQ Section
entities.description: One released section of a case: what was released, why, and for which department. App twin of the portal section. The K2.1 row carries the component list and the search fields.
key_attributes: X2 set 1:1 with the portal: section item key, case code, cycle, supplier code, section key/code/title/sort, applicability, supplier reason, added later, origin, Definition_JSON and hash, due date, contacts

business_rules.statement: A Process is used only when the record moves through steps that carry SLAs (built-in SLA notifications); otherwise a Data Form. No process without steps.

No extra records: repeated detail lives in a child table inside its parent (or fields on the parent) when one writer, no integration on rows, few bounded rows and no cross-case search all hold; otherwise its own record.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L24; brd.md L96; brd.md L105-L111

business_rules.statement: Exactly 11 flows: 3 Processes (CIQ Case, CIQ Open Point, CIQ Change Request) and 8 Data Forms; dropped entities (Raw Material, Case Contact, Supplier Contact, Component, Config Release, per-round items, per-criterion RMES rows) are not reintroduced.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L13; brd.md L115; brd.md L131-L138

business_rules.statement: Use parallel steps where Kissflow supports them: Part 2 review on the case and Assess impact on the change request.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L25; brd.md L188; brd.md L271

business_rules.statement: Child-table step permissions name the child table only, never its columns.
A child-table column never reuses a header field id; it gets a prefixed id (e.g. Rounds_Round_No).
No native aggregates are authored. Gates and holds use plain Number count fields written by the acting person's Workbench at their own step, read by server-side formulas.
Gate and hold formulas are blank-safe: a blank count holds and never deadlocks.
List ids are authored without the _A00 suffix.

Only intra-app automations are modelled: Z1 (case completed → PDF, e-mails, notification event), Z2 (case rejected/cancellation → neutral e-mail), Z3/Z4 (SLA breach on CIQ Case / CIQ Open Point → audit event). They come out incomplete and are finished over REST.
Cross-container integrations X1–X6 and Y1/Y3–Y6 are documentation only (the portal session builds them); no automation points at a portal flow.
No field is named Name, Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project; generic words are owner-prefixed.
Every flow and list name starts with 'CIQ '.

Step names are exact (en-dash U+2013 where shown): 'Waiting for supplier: basic data', 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05', 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11', 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review', 'Review – Regulatory/Safety/QM/Microbiology/Sustainability/RMM', 'Open items check – before release request', 'Overall approval', 'Open items check – before close'; Open Point 'Waiting for supplier'; Change Request 'Triage' then parallel 'Assess impact' with 'Assess – Regulatory' … 'Assess – Sustainability'. The portal triggers on these names.
Editable on a Process also grants item creation, and flow Admin cannot be expressed; both are fixed over REST after generate.
No pages are added (backend only, --no-pages): a page auto-grant turns readers into editors.
The account key cannot act after Start; every human step is done by a person (Workbench or native), never by the sync service.
CIQ Sync Service is in scope: close sweep, snapshots, X2/X3 fallback, single-writer audit, component rebuild, PDF renderer (option A).
Overall approval, when switched on, comes before the PS-11 release request.
Safety and Regulatory reviewers record their internal RMES decision themselves; no separate approver roles.
No four-eyes on configuration releases.
The audit trail is claimed as 'tamper-evident'.
Roles are exactly the 11 custom roles plus the defaults Admin and User.
Never model, reference or write portal (CIQP) flows or the 'CIQ ZZ Spike' test flows in this app.

Case creation requires material, supplier, case contacts (Portal_Contact_Ids, Confirm_Contact_Ids, Supplier_Contact_Emails mandatory at Start), owner and due dates; the pinned Release row is copied in.
The BASIC section row is created only after the case submit succeeds.
CIQ RMM creates the case and holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and both checks; after the K-FA test the basic-data step is assigned from Owner_RMM.

Every case step carries an SLA whose duration Beiersdorf sets; supplier waiting steps use the supplier due date and escalate to the owner; review steps have a reminder and an escalation (REQ-RMES-019).
Scope can be extended with a justification but never reduced; every scope run records additions only.
One CIQ Section row per Mandatory or Optional section; N.A. sections get no row but stay in the scope run with their rule and answer.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L186; brd.md L125; brd.md L986

business_rules.statement: A Part 2 branch runs only when Dept_<D>_Active = 'Yes'; the RMM branch is off by default; the case moves on only when every active branch is done (native join).
A department's Part 2 sign-off is blocked while it has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings — by the Workbench and by a native gate field on count fields.
Each Part 2 branch writes only its own 5–7 lane fields and no child tables; nobody else writes the case during Part 2 (contact changes via a Contact-update point, assignments via audit events).
'Open items check – before release request' and '– before close' run only if something is open (a blank count also holds); an override needs a reason and is audited.

Overall approval runs only if Overall_Approval_Required = 'Yes' (off by default); approve only if every required RMES decision is Approved; on rejection the case ends without a release request and a neutral closing text goes to the supplier.
'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11' is skipped if overall-rejected; X5 sends the single release request (REQ-PROC-040); RMM can complete manually with a reason (REQ-PROC-045).

Cancellation: RMM rejects at its own steps; in Part 2 the Case Admin rejects via the admin route; an audit Cancellation event is written; the case's open P2/P3 items are ended; the close sweep snapshots and withdraws every open portal item (REQ-PROC-049). The same sweep runs after an overall rejection or a manual completion.
End of the case triggers Z1: PDF, e-mails to the RMM owner and the supplier contacts, notification log.

Case identity and material fields are plain scalars (Trade_Name, Main_INCI, BDF_Material_No as Text that X1 reads); case contacts are fields, never a child table, because integrations can read only fields.
RMES_Key plus RMES_Created_At from Y4 are the case's single RMES record header (REQ-PROC-021).
After generate: Case Send-back off on every step and Reject only on RMM steps; Open Point Send-back only at review steps; Change Request Send-back and Reject off.
Raising an open point requires kind, owner department, to-supplier yes/no, reference, question, supplier-facing justification, responsible person, internal and supplier due dates (REQ-ADR-001).
Every open point blocks its department's sign-off and the release request until closed (REQ-PROC-036).
'Waiting for supplier' runs only when OP_To_Supplier = 'Yes'; internal kinds (Department review, Contact update, Internal review) skip it.
Exactly one review step runs, chosen by OP_Dept; only the owning department reviews the answer (REQ-PROC-034).

Review outcomes: Accepted (records the accepted document), Withdrawn (with reason), or Return (round appended to Rounds, next question/justification/due date written, answer cleared, Awaiting_Response = 'Yes', item sent back to 'Waiting for supplier').
Y3 approves 'Waiting for supplier' only while Awaiting_Response = 'Yes'.
Only the owning department writes the Rounds child table, at its own step.
App_Open_Point_Id means the point, not the round; each round still gets its own CIQP Query with its round number.
An additional part asks RMM (or the sync service) to create its CIQ Section row.
Change requests are created by Y6 from the portal (RMM by hand as fallback) and triaged by CIQ RMM, who checks the requester is a contact of the case.
A change attempt after PS-11 is refused and logged as an audit 'change attempt' event (REQ-PROC-043).
A change notice writes a new scope run (additions only); new sections become section rows and a Department-review point is raised for each new section's lead department.
Each Assess branch runs only if Impact_<D> = 'Yes' and writes only its own four fields; re-assessment goes into that department's RMES sheet; the change request end sends X6 (CIQP Notice).
CIQ Supplier is written by CIQ RMM; Business Admin is Viewer unless BDF says otherwise; contact rows are written one at a time, re-read and merged.
A portal user serving two suppliers gets a contact row under each supplier.

CIQ Config Version is written by CIQ Business Admin as member without Delete (K-17); copy-on-write: publishing never edits a row; each publish writes an audit event; versions are downloadable (REQ-CFG-001/-003).
A Release row holds the full bundle plus hash so a pinned release never depends on rows that could change.
CIQ Section is written only by CIQ RMM and CIQ Integration Service; reviewers are Viewers.
K2.1 Components are rebuilt from the portal answers (read via sharing) whenever they change and once after the final release.
CIQ Scope Run rows are written by the session that ran the rules: RMM, or a department for an extension.
CIQ RMES Safety is written by Safety only; Regulatory can read but not edit it, and vice versa for CIQ RMES Regulatory (REQ-CFG-004).
One RMES row per case and department, created by the first session after PS-05 and keyed by RMES_Key; the Editing_By/Editing_Since lock allows only one writer at a time.
Every internal role writes CIQ Internal Note; the author edits only their own messages by convention; never visible to suppliers (REQ-PROC-020).
CIQ Audit Event: recommended single writer CIQ Integration Service with every person Viewer; otherwise writers without Delete and the claim is 'tamper-evident' (REQ-CTL-009, REQ-CTL-010).
Never shared with the portal: department lanes and decisions, RMES, findings, internal notes, internal due dates, the overall decision, the audit trail.
Section answers and uploads are read from the portal through flow sharing, not copied.

data_scope.rule: All internal roles read all records of every flow they are granted (scope 'all'); v4 defines no record-level isolation for Beiersdorf roles. 'Own lane' on the case and 'own department' on open points are enforced by step ownership and branch-scoped field permissions, not by a row filter. CIQ RMES Safety/Regulatory isolation is by write grant only (the other department reads, REQ-CFG-004). Future views/dashboards (Workbench) must reuse this map.

hard_rules.rule: No pages (--no-pages). Any native page/card on a flow auto-grants its target roles as editors and would break every V cell, in particular CIQ RMES Safety/Regulatory isolation (REQ-CFG-004) and the read-only CIQ Reader.
CIQ Case Admin members must also hold CIQ RMM; Case Admin carries only flow Admin on the three Processes, View on Forms, and write on CIQ Internal Note and CIQ Audit Event.
The supplier has no app role and no grant; portal flows (CIQP *) are never granted here.
CIQ Integration Service never acts on a human step after Start; it initiates CIQ Change Request (Y6) only and writes CIQ Section and CIQ Audit Event rows.
Child tables are keyed at TABLE level only in step permissions; every header field and child table is keyed explicitly at every task step (unlisted = ReadOnly).

satisfiability.note: Derived from the executable grants above: initiator:true only on business-authorized creators; each first step (StartEvent) is Act for exactly the initiators; every other task step is Act for exactly its workflow assignee_role. No flow has zero creators or zero readers.

residual_risks.risk: CIQ Audit Event is written by people (Q3 default), so the claim is 'tamper-evident', not immutable. Until K-17 proves a Form member without Delete, the engine's Editable Form grant may include Delete.
residual_risks.mitigation: Post-generate REST reset to no-Delete; hash chain per A3 L66; the single-writer option (service only) stays available if BDF wants immutability.

residual_risks.risk: Step-owning roles (5 Reviewers on CIQ Case and CIQ Change Request, CIQ Overall Approver on CIQ Case) come out of generate with InitiateItems and can raise items natively until the REST reset.
residual_risks.mitigation: post_generate_grants; the Workbench hides '+ New' for them.

residual_risks.risk: CIQ Open Point Start is Act for RMM and all five Reviewers (v4 L237); the engine assigns the start step's owner as ciq_rmm. Any Reviewer can raise for any department; the owning department is a field (OP_Dept), not a grant.
residual_risks.mitigation: Workbench preselects OP_Dept from the raiser's role; review step ownership (OPNT_R_<D>) enforces 'only the owning department reviews' (REQ-PROC-034).

residual_risks.risk: Form grants are per Form (C4): every CIQ Scope Run / CIQ Internal Note writer can edit every row, including other departments' runs and other authors' notes.
residual_risks.mitigation: Convention (v4 L284 'by convention') plus F8 audit events.

residual_risks.risk: Conformance #3: a Form grant does not carry its child table (the compiled parent FlowPermission has no column entry for Contacts/Components/Criteria/Findings). The security IR accepts a grant keyed on the child-table id and compiles a separate FlowPermission on that child model, so each child table now mirrors its parent Form cell. Whether the platform applies a member grant on a child model, and whether it is what lets a non-admin write rows, is [unverified, K-17].
residual_risks.mitigation: K-17 acceptance test: as a non-admin CIQ RMM user add/edit/delete a Contacts row on a CIQ Supplier item; as CIQ Safety Reviewer add a Criteria and a Findings row on CIQ RMES Safety; as CIQ Regulatory Reviewer try the same on CIQ RMES Safety (must be refused) and on CIQ RMES Regulatory (must succeed); as CIQ Reader confirm rows are visible and read-only. If generate rejects a child-model grant, drop those 61 grants (Forms stay editable after publish) and grant the child-table column on the parent over REST.

residual_risks.risk: Step-level Mandatory on the blank-safe gate formulas (Start_Gate at OPNT_S0; REG_Gate, SAF_Gate, QM_Gate, MIC_Gate, SUS_Gate, RMM_Gate at the CASE_B_<D> lanes; Open_Items_Gate_Release at CASE_S5 and Open_Items_Gate_Close at CASE_S8, the two per-check gates that replaced Open_Items_Gate under COH-10) blocks submit while a count is blank; this is intended (A2 L34) but a native My Tasks user without the Workbench must write the counts by hand.
residual_risks.mitigation: The counts each gate reads are Editable at the same step: <D>_Open_Count (and REG/SAF_RMES_Gaps) at CASE_B_<D>; Open_Items_Count and Open_CR_Count plus the per-check override reason (Hold_Override_Reason_Release at CASE_S5, Hold_Override_Reason_Close at CASE_S8) (D10, D15, D23).

payload.name: Create a CIQ case
payload.trigger: RMM decides to qualify a supplier raw material (a new case cycle)
steps: Enter the material (trade name, main INCI, BDF, SAP and IRMA numbers) as plain case fields
Pick the supplier from CIQ Supplier and set the case contacts (contact list for display, portal contact ids, confirm contact ids, supplier contact e-mails)
Set owner and due dates
The pinned Release row (id, hash, manifest copy) is copied into the case
Submit; only after the submit succeeds the BASIC CIQ Section row is created (which creates the portal section)
payload.outcome: A case at 'Waiting for supplier: basic data' with a pinned release and a BASIC section released to the portal
success_criteria: Missing mandatory data blocks creation
Contacts are fields on the case, never a child table
Exactly one BASIC section row per case
payload.evidence: brd.md L184; brd.md L197-L199; brd.md L330; brd.md L335

payload.name: Receive the supplier's basic data
payload.trigger: The case enters 'Waiting for supplier: basic data'
steps: X1 creates the CIQP Request in the portal
The supplier submits basic data in the portal
Y1 sets 'basic data received' and the portal request id, and the step is approved
Fallback: RMM checks the portal and submits the step by hand
payload.outcome: Case moves to Scope check
success_criteria: Supplier due date drives the step SLA and escalates to the owner
payload.evidence: brd.md L185; brd.md L291; brd.md L296; brd.md L782

payload.name: Scope check and section release
payload.trigger: Basic data received (case at 'Scope check')
steps: Check BASIC answers (read through flow sharing); if incomplete, raise a query and wait
Run the scope rules into a CIQ Scope Run (every section incl. N.A., with rule and answer)
Optionally extend the scope with a justification (never reduce)
Release one CIQ Section row per Mandatory or Optional section (X2 creates each portal section)
Set which departments are active (Dept_<D>_Active) and the RMES key
payload.outcome: Scope recorded, sections with the supplier, departments for Part 2 fixed; case moves to completeness PS-05
payload.frequency: once per case (plus later runs for extensions, change notices, additional parts)
success_criteria: Additions only
N.A. sections get no section row but stay in the scope run with their rule
Scope-check SLA
payload.evidence: brd.md L186; brd.md L280-L281; brd.md L783

payload.name: Obtain the completeness confirmation (PS-05)
payload.trigger: Case enters 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05'
steps: X4 creates the CIQP Completeness Confirmation
The supplier confirms (name, e-mail, role, time)
Y4 records the confirmation and RMES_Created_At (RMES header) and approves
payload.outcome: Questionnaire confirmed complete (data stays editable); exactly one RMES record header per case; Part 2 starts
success_criteria: Supplier due-date SLA
Completeness confirmation is not the final release
payload.evidence: brd.md L187; brd.md L203; brd.md L294; brd.md L298; brd.md L560

properties.name: Department review and sign-off in Part 2

payload.name: Department review and sign-off in Part 2
payload.trigger: The parallel block 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review' starts; each active department's branch opens (RMM branch off by default)
steps: Review the sections the department leads
Raise open points to the supplier or internally as needed
Safety and Regulatory fill their RMES sheet (see j06)
Workbench writes the department's open-item counts at its own step
Sign off only the own lane fields: confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of (SAF/REG also internal RMES decision and reason)
Delegation recorded via on-behalf-of and an audit event
payload.outcome: Every active department's branch is done; native join moves the case on
payload.frequency: once per active department per case
success_criteria: Submit blocked while the department has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings
Inactive department branches are skipped
Review SLA with reminder and escalation (REQ-RMES-019)
payload.evidence: brd.md L188-L189; brd.md L201; brd.md L208-L212; brd.md L825

payload.name: Fill the RMES sheet (Safety / Regulatory)
payload.trigger: First Safety (resp. Regulatory) session after PS-05
steps: Create the department's single RMES row for the case, keyed by the case's RMES_Key, with a reference to the case
Take the edit lock (Editing_By / Editing_Since)
Record each criterion: applicability, source, prefill, result, comment, limit check, impact resolution, AI suggestion and who confirmed it
Record findings (text, criterion, blocking, state, linked open point)
Lift header counts (open criteria, open blocking findings) for the case gate
Record the internal RMES decision on the case lane
payload.outcome: A complete RMES sheet per department per case whose counts allow the lane sign-off
payload.frequency: once per case per department (plus re-assessments)
success_criteria: Only one Safety (resp. Regulatory) user writes at a time
Regulatory can read Safety but not edit it, and vice versa
payload.evidence: brd.md L282-L283; brd.md L331; brd.md L376; brd.md L433

properties.name: Clarify with the supplier through an open point

payload.name: Clarify with the supplier through an open point
payload.trigger: A department (or RMM at Scope check) needs a query answered, a document, or an additional part
steps: Raise the point: kind, owner department, to-supplier yes, reference (section, field, row or document by file name and upload date), question, supplier-facing justification, responsible person, internal and supplier due dates
Additional part: RMM or the sync service creates its CIQ Section row
X3 creates the portal query for the current round
Supplier responds; Y3 copies the answer, sets Awaiting_Response = No and approves
The owning department reviews: Accepted (records the accepted document), Withdrawn (with reason), or Return (round appended to Rounds, next question written, item sent back to 'Waiting for supplier')
payload.outcome: The point is closed (Accepted or Withdrawn) with its full round history in one item
payload.frequency: many per case, mainly in Part 2
success_criteria: Every open point blocks its department's sign-off and the release request until closed
Only the owning department reviews the answer
Responsible person and due dates are required
payload.evidence: brd.md L224-L229; brd.md L236-L246; brd.md L249-L251

properties.name: Handle late and internal work through internal open points

payload.name: Handle late and internal work through internal open points
payload.trigger: A department is activated after the fork, a completed department's basis changed, contacts must change after PS-05, or a co-review is wanted
steps: Raise an internal open point (Department review / Contact update / Internal review); the supplier step is skipped
The owning department reviews and closes it
Its accepted outcome counts as the department's completion for that scope
payload.outcome: Late work has a task with an owner, and the holds count it
success_criteria: No one writes the case during Part 2; contact changes go through a Contact update point
payload.evidence: brd.md L231-L234; brd.md L210; brd.md L424; brd.md L426

properties.name: Clear leftovers at the open-items checks

payload.name: Clear leftovers at the open-items checks
payload.trigger: After the Part 2 join (before release request) or after the final release step (before close), something is still open or a count is blank
steps: Resolve late department reviews and contact updates
Copy late completions
Or override with a reason, which is audited
payload.outcome: Nothing open blocks the release request or the close
success_criteria: A blank count holds; the gate never deadlocks
Normal path stays automatic
payload.evidence: brd.md L190; brd.md L193; brd.md L32-L34

payload.name: Overall approval
payload.trigger: Case reaches 'Overall approval' and Overall_Approval_Required = Yes
steps: Check every required RMES decision
Approve, or reject with a neutral closing text
payload.outcome: Approved: the release request goes out. Rejected: the case ends without a release request and the close sweep runs
payload.frequency: per case when switched on (off by default)
success_criteria: Approve only if every required RMES decision is Approved
Comes before the PS-11 release request
payload.evidence: brd.md L191; brd.md L63; brd.md L220

payload.name: Final release (PS-11) and close
payload.trigger: Case enters 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11' (not overall-rejected)
steps: X5 sends the single release request
Supplier releases; Y5 records the release (released revisions, evidence list) and approves
Or RMM completes manually with a reason
Open items check before close if something opened during this step
End: Z1 produces the PDF, e-mails the RMM owner and the supplier contacts, logs the notification
payload.outcome: Case completed with a final PDF; nothing editable by the supplier afterwards
success_criteria: Exactly one release request per case (REQ-PROC-040)
Manual completion carries a reason (REQ-PROC-045)
payload.evidence: brd.md L192-L194; brd.md L301; brd.md L62

payload.name: Cancel a case
payload.trigger: The case must stop before completion
steps: RMM rejects at its own steps; in Part 2 the Case Admin rejects through the admin route
A Cancellation audit event is written
The case's open open points and change requests are ended
The close sweep snapshots and withdraws every open portal item
Z2 sends a neutral e-mail to the supplier
payload.outcome: Case cancelled with no supplier task left open (REQ-PROC-049)
success_criteria: Same sweep after an overall rejection or a manual completion
payload.evidence: brd.md L214-L220; brd.md L38; brd.md L413

payload.name: Handle a supplier change request
payload.trigger: Supplier submits a change request or change notice in the portal (Y6 creates the app item; RMM by hand as fallback)
steps: Triage: check the requester is a contact of the case
After PS-11: refuse and write a 'change attempt' audit event
Change notice: new scope run (additions only); new sections become section rows; a Department-review point for each new section's lead department
Set impact flags per department and the supplier-safe outcome text
Affected departments assess in parallel ('Assess – <dept>'), each writing only its own four fields; re-assessment goes into the RMES sheet
End: X6 sends the CIQP Notice with the outcome
payload.outcome: Scope re-derived, affected departments informed and assessed, supplier notified
payload.frequency: whenever a supplier changes configuration/metadata answers or asks for a correction
success_criteria: Every configuration answer change re-derives the scope (REQ-CFG-008, REQ-PROC-007)
Attempts after release refused and logged (REQ-PROC-043)
Affected departments informed (REQ-PROC-031)
payload.evidence: brd.md L255-L272; brd.md L295; brd.md L299

payload.name: Maintain suppliers and their contacts
payload.trigger: A new supplier or contact is needed for a case, or contact data changes
steps: Create or update the supplier (code, legal name, DUNS, kind, country, SAP and Teamcenter ids, active, test)
Add contacts as rows: name, e-mail, role, may confirm, portal user id, active, invite requested/invited
Write rows one at a time, re-read and merge
Keep the parent mirrors (contact portal ids for search, pending invites count)
payload.outcome: Every contact on a case has a portal user id; suppliers are searchable
success_criteria: One portal user serving two suppliers gets a row under each
Supplier_Code is the isolation key on every portal item

payload.name: Author and publish configuration

Each publish writes an audit event
Download any version

success_criteria: No four-eyes (A3)
No delete for the writer (K-17)

payload.name: Business Admin (configuration)
payload.description: Maintains the CIQ configuration without an IT ticket: templates, section definitions, rule sets, section ownership, RMES criteria, limits, texts, reminders, settings, and publishes Release rows that cases pin.
goals: Draft and publish a new configuration version copy-on-write, never editing a published row
Publish a Release row holding the full frozen bundle and its hash
Download any configuration version
pain_points: Published configuration must not be editable or deletable
payload.evidence: brd.md L146; brd.md L279; brd.md L375; brd.md L430

payload.name: Case Admin
payload.description: Administers cases in exceptional situations: rejects (cancels) a case through the admin route while it is in Part 2 or overall approval, and ends a cancelled case's open open points and change requests. Becomes flow Admin over REST after generate. Its members also hold CIQ RMM (PART D).
goals: Cancel a case at a step RMM does not hold
End the open P2/P3 items of a cancelled case
pain_points: App Builder cannot express flow Admin; it is set over REST after generate
payload.evidence: brd.md L148; brd.md L215; brd.md L217; brd.md L416; brd.md L1242

payload.name: Integration Service (CIQ Sync Service + integrations)
payload.description: The identity of the CIQ Sync Service (a small server-side service with API keys) and the integrations. Runs the close sweep, snapshots, PDF renderer, K2.1 component rebuild, portal-item creation as fallback for X2/X3, and the single-writer audit. It never acts on a human step after Start.
goals: Leave no open supplier task after cancellation, overall rejection or manual completion
Render the final PDF
Rebuild K2.1 components from portal answers
Write audit events
pain_points: The account key cannot act after Start
payload.evidence: brd.md L149; brd.md L280; brd.md L285; brd.md L318-L320; brd.md L357-L364; brd.md L406; brd.md L61-L62

payload.name: Microbiology Reviewer
payload.description: Beiersdorf Microbiology department reviewer. Reviews the sections the department leads in its own Part 2 branch 'Review – Microbiology', raises and reviews its own open points, assesses change-request impact in 'Assess – Microbiology', and signs off only its own lane fields.
goals: Review the Microbiology-led sections and sign off the MIC lane (confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of)
Ask the supplier specific, referenced questions and accept, withdraw or return each answer
Assess the impact of supplier change requests on earlier assessments
pain_points: Sign-off must be blocked while the department still has open points, unassessed change requests
payload.evidence: brd.md L144; brd.md L158; brd.md L189; brd.md L246; brd.md L271; brd.md L1238

payload.name: Overall Approver
payload.description: Gives the optional overall approval of a case after Part 2 and before the supplier's final release, only when the case's overall-approval switch is on (off by default).
goals: Approve only when every required RMES decision is Approved
Reject with a neutral closing text to the supplier, which ends the case without a release request
payload.evidence: brd.md L145; brd.md L159; brd.md L191; brd.md L374

payload.name: QM Reviewer
payload.description: Beiersdorf QM department reviewer. Reviews the sections the department leads in its own Part 2 branch 'Review – QM', raises and reviews its own open points, assesses change-request impact in 'Assess – QM', and signs off only its own lane fields.
goals: Review the QM-led sections and sign off the QM lane (confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of)
Ask the supplier specific, referenced questions and accept, withdraw or return each answer
Assess the impact of supplier change requests on earlier assessments
pain_points: Sign-off must be blocked while the department still has open points, unassessed change requests
payload.evidence: brd.md L144; brd.md L158; brd.md L189; brd.md L246; brd.md L271; brd.md L1238

payload.name: Reader (Customs, Legal, Auditor, Process Owner)
payload.description: Read-only Beiersdorf stakeholders: Customs, Legal, Auditor and Process Owner. They inspect cases, sections, decisions and the audit trail; they take part in the internal chat but take no workflow step.
goals: See case status, sections and outcomes
Inspect the tamper-evident audit trail
Post internal notes on a case
payload.evidence: brd.md L147; brd.md L284; brd.md L1241

payload.name: Regulatory Reviewer
payload.description: Beiersdorf Regulatory department reviewer. Reviews the sections the department leads in its own Part 2 branch 'Review – Regulatory', raises and reviews its own open points, assesses change-request impact in 'Assess – Regulatory', fills the Regulatory RMES sheet and records the internal Regulatory RMES decision, and signs off only its own lane fields.
goals: Review the Regulatory-led sections and sign off the REG lane (confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of)
Ask the supplier specific, referenced questions and accept, withdraw or return each answer
Assess the impact of supplier change requests on earlier assessments
Fill the Regulatory RMES sheet (criteria, findings) and record the internal RMES decision with a reason
pain_points: Sign-off must be blocked while the department still has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings
payload.evidence: brd.md L144; brd.md L158; brd.md L189; brd.md L246; brd.md L271; brd.md L1238

payload.name: Raw Material Manager (RMM)
payload.description: Owns the CIQ case end to end and is the single intermediary between the Beiersdorf departments and the supplier. Creates the case, holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and every check, runs scope check, triages change requests, maintains suppliers and contacts, and owns the optional RMM review branch (off by default).
goals: Create a case with all mandatory material, supplier, contact, owner and due-date data
Release the right scope (one section per Mandatory/Optional section, extend never reduce) and activate the right departments
Move the case through basic data, completeness PS-05, Part 2 review, optional overall approval and the single final release PS-11
Resolve leftovers at the two open-items checks, or override with an audited reason
Triage supplier change requests and refuse attempts after the final release
Cancel a case cleanly so no supplier task is left open; complete manually with a reason when needed
Keep supplier companies and their contacts (portal user ids) correct
pain_points: Kissflow has no field-change trigger, so supplier answer changes must arrive as change notices
Nobody may write the case during Part 2, so contact changes need their own open point
Native aggregates are unreliable, so gates depend on count fields written by the acting person
payload.evidence: brd.md L143; brd.md L157; brd.md L184-L193; brd.md L270; brd.md L278

payload.name: Safety Reviewer
payload.description: Beiersdorf Safety department reviewer. Reviews the sections the department leads in its own Part 2 branch 'Review – Safety', raises and reviews its own open points, assesses change-request impact in 'Assess – Safety', fills the Safety RMES sheet and records the internal Safety RMES decision, and signs off only its own lane fields.
goals: Review the Safety-led sections and sign off the SAF lane (confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of)
Ask the supplier specific, referenced questions and accept, withdraw or return each answer
Assess the impact of supplier change requests on earlier assessments
Fill the Safety RMES sheet (criteria, findings) and record the internal RMES decision with a reason
pain_points: Sign-off must be blocked while the department still has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings
payload.evidence: brd.md L144; brd.md L158; brd.md L189; brd.md L246; brd.md L271; brd.md L1238

payload.name: Supplier contact (external)
payload.source_role: Supplier (portal role only; no app access)
payload.description: A supplier company's contact person. Acts only in the separate CIQ Supplier Portal: submits basic data, fills sections, answers queries, confirms completeness (PS-05), gives the single final release (PS-11), raises change requests and acknowledges notices. Has no role and no access in CIQ Digital; their actions reach the app only through the Y integrations.
goals: Answer only what is asked, once, with clear references and due dates
Change configuration/metadata answers until the final release
Get an outcome for each change request
pain_points: Must never see internal notes, RMES, findings, lanes, internal due dates, the overall decision or the audit trail
payload.evidence: brd.md L78; brd.md L160; brd.md L262; brd.md L265; brd.md L316; brd.md L455

payload.statement: Child-table step permissions name the child table only, never its columns.
A child-table column never reuses a header field id; it gets a prefixed id (e.g. Rounds_Round_No).
No native aggregates are authored. Gates and holds use plain Number count fields written by the acting person's Workbench at their own step, read by server-side formulas.
Gate and hold formulas are blank-safe: a blank count holds and never deadlocks.
List ids are authored without the _A00 suffix.

Only intra-app automations are modelled: Z1 (case completed → PDF, e-mails, notification event), Z2 (case rejected/cancellation → neutral e-mail), Z3/Z4 (SLA breach on CIQ Case / CIQ Open Point → audit event). They come out incomplete and are finished over REST.
Cross-container integrations X1–X6 and Y1/Y3–Y6 are documentation only (the portal session builds them); no automation points at a portal flow.
No field is named Name, Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project; generic words are owner-prefixed.
Every flow and list name starts with 'CIQ '.

Step names are exact (en-dash U+2013 where shown): 'Waiting for supplier: basic data', 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05', 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11', 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review', 'Review – Regulatory/Safety/QM/Microbiology/Sustainability/RMM', 'Open items check – before release request', 'Overall approval', 'Open items check – before close'; Open Point 'Waiting for supplier'; Change Request 'Triage' then parallel 'Assess impact' with 'Assess – Regulatory' … 'Assess – Sustainability'. The portal triggers on these names.
Editable on a Process also grants item creation, and flow Admin cannot be expressed; both are fixed over REST after generate.
No pages are added (backend only, --no-pages): a page auto-grant turns readers into editors.
The account key cannot act after Start; every human step is done by a person (Workbench or native), never by the sync service.
CIQ Sync Service is in scope: close sweep, snapshots, X2/X3 fallback, single-writer audit, component rebuild, PDF renderer (option A).
Overall approval, when switched on, comes before the PS-11 release request.
Safety and Regulatory reviewers record their internal RMES decision themselves; no separate approver roles.
No four-eyes on configuration releases.
The audit trail is claimed as 'tamper-evident'.
Roles are exactly the 11 custom roles plus the defaults Admin and User.
Never model, reference or write portal (CIQP) flows or the 'CIQ ZZ Spike' test flows in this app.

Case creation requires material, supplier, case contacts (Portal_Contact_Ids, Confirm_Contact_Ids, Supplier_Contact_Emails mandatory at Start), owner and due dates; the pinned Release row is copied in.
The BASIC section row is created only after the case submit succeeds.
CIQ RMM creates the case and holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and both checks; after the K-FA test the basic-data step is assigned from Owner_RMM.

Every case step carries an SLA whose duration Beiersdorf sets; supplier waiting steps use the supplier due date and escalate to the owner; review steps have a reminder and an escalation (REQ-RMES-019).
Scope can be extended with a justification but never reduced; every scope run records additions only.
One CIQ Section row per Mandatory or Optional section; N.A. sections get no row but stay in the scope run with their rule and answer.

payload.statement: A Part 2 branch runs only when Dept_<D>_Active = 'Yes'; the RMM branch is off by default; the case moves on only when every active branch is done (native join).
A department's Part 2 sign-off is blocked while it has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings — by the Workbench and by a native gate field on count fields.
Each Part 2 branch writes only its own 5–7 lane fields and no child tables; nobody else writes the case during Part 2 (contact changes via a Contact-update point, assignments via audit events).
'Open items check – before release request' and '– before close' run only if something is open (a blank count also holds); an override needs a reason and is audited.

Overall approval runs only if Overall_Approval_Required = 'Yes' (off by default); approve only if every required RMES decision is Approved; on rejection the case ends without a release request and a neutral closing text goes to the supplier.
'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11' is skipped if overall-rejected; X5 sends the single release request (REQ-PROC-040); RMM can complete manually with a reason (REQ-PROC-045).

Cancellation: RMM rejects at its own steps; in Part 2 the Case Admin rejects via the admin route; an audit Cancellation event is written; the case's open P2/P3 items are ended; the close sweep snapshots and withdraws every open portal item (REQ-PROC-049). The same sweep runs after an overall rejection or a manual completion.
End of the case triggers Z1: PDF, e-mails to the RMM owner and the supplier contacts, notification log.

Case identity and material fields are plain scalars (Trade_Name, Main_INCI, BDF_Material_No as Text that X1 reads); case contacts are fields, never a child table, because integrations can read only fields.
RMES_Key plus RMES_Created_At from Y4 are the case's single RMES record header (REQ-PROC-021).
After generate: Case Send-back off on every step and Reject only on RMM steps; Open Point Send-back only at review steps; Change Request Send-back and Reject off.
Raising an open point requires kind, owner department, to-supplier yes/no, reference, question, supplier-facing justification, responsible person, internal and supplier due dates (REQ-ADR-001).
Every open point blocks its department's sign-off and the release request until closed (REQ-PROC-036).
'Waiting for supplier' runs only when OP_To_Supplier = 'Yes'; internal kinds (Department review, Contact update, Internal review) skip it.
Exactly one review step runs, chosen by OP_Dept; only the owning department reviews the answer (REQ-PROC-034).

Review outcomes: Accepted (records the accepted document), Withdrawn (with reason), or Return (round appended to Rounds, next question/justification/due date written, answer cleared, Awaiting_Response = 'Yes', item sent back to 'Waiting for supplier').
Y3 approves 'Waiting for supplier' only while Awaiting_Response = 'Yes'.
Only the owning department writes the Rounds child table, at its own step.
App_Open_Point_Id means the point, not the round; each round still gets its own CIQP Query with its round number.
An additional part asks RMM (or the sync service) to create its CIQ Section row.
Change requests are created by Y6 from the portal (RMM by hand as fallback) and triaged by CIQ RMM, who checks the requester is a contact of the case.
A change attempt after PS-11 is refused and logged as an audit 'change attempt' event (REQ-PROC-043).
A change notice writes a new scope run (additions only); new sections become section rows and a Department-review point is raised for each new section's lead department.
Each Assess branch runs only if Impact_<D> = 'Yes' and writes only its own four fields; re-assessment goes into that department's RMES sheet; the change request end sends X6 (CIQP Notice).
CIQ Supplier is written by CIQ RMM; Business Admin is Viewer unless BDF says otherwise; contact rows are written one at a time, re-read and merged.
A portal user serving two suppliers gets a contact row under each supplier.

CIQ Config Version is written by CIQ Business Admin as member without Delete (K-17); copy-on-write: publishing never edits a row; each publish writes an audit event; versions are downloadable (REQ-CFG-001/-003).
A Release row holds the full bundle plus hash so a pinned release never depends on rows that could change.
CIQ Section is written only by CIQ RMM and CIQ Integration Service; reviewers are Viewers.
K2.1 Components are rebuilt from the portal answers (read via sharing) whenever they change and once after the final release.
CIQ Scope Run rows are written by the session that ran the rules: RMM, or a department for an extension.
CIQ RMES Safety is written by Safety only; Regulatory can read but not edit it, and vice versa for CIQ RMES Regulatory (REQ-CFG-004).
One RMES row per case and department, created by the first session after PS-05 and keyed by RMES_Key; the Editing_By/Editing_Since lock allows only one writer at a time.
Every internal role writes CIQ Internal Note; the author edits only their own messages by convention; never visible to suppliers (REQ-PROC-020).
CIQ Audit Event: recommended single writer CIQ Integration Service with every person Viewer; otherwise writers without Delete and the claim is 'tamper-evident' (REQ-CTL-009, REQ-CTL-010).
Never shared with the portal: department lanes and decisions, RMES, findings, internal notes, internal due dates, the overall decision, the audit trail.
Section answers and uploads are read from the portal through flow sharing, not copied.

id_reservations.note: Flow ids are the name-derived ids we expect (name with underscores + _A00); the platform assigns the real ids, read back after generate. List ids carry NO _A00 suffix so display names stay clean (A2 L35). Role ids are stable IR slugs; live role _ids are read back. Step ids are prefixed per flow (CASE_, OPNT_, CHRQ_) so they can't collide with field ids such as OP_Key or CR_Key.

CIQ_Case_A00.lane_prefix: <D>_ for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS, RMM
CIQ_Case_A00.rule: v4 names first (L197-L206, L189, L191), then PART D L733-L782 where it agrees with v4. Material fields are plain Text on the case (no CIQ Raw Material, L132). Contacts are fields, never a child table (L330). Gate and hold counts are plain Number fields written by the acting person's Workbench (A2 L32-L33, e.g. Open_Items_Count, Open_CR_Count, <D>_Open_Count, <D>_RMES_Gaps) read by blank-safe formulas; no aggregates. The step-condition fields above are reserved.

CIQ_Open_Point_A00.rule: v4 L244-L251, then PART D L887-L912 where it agrees (one item per point, not per round). Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Rounds columns use the Rounds_ prefix (A2 L31).

CIQ_Change_Request_A00.prefix: CR_ for identity and outcome; Impact_<D> and <D>_ assessment fields for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS
CIQ_Change_Request_A00.rule: v4 L267-L272, then PART D L957-L966. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Y6 fills the case keys it has (Case_Code, Cycle_No); RMM sets Case_Item_Id at Triage.

CIQ_Supplier_A00.rule: v4 L278, then PART D L1109. Contacts columns use the Contacts_ prefix (A2 L31). Never 'Country': use Supplier_Country_Code.

CIQ_Config_Version_A00.prefix: Config_ for version fields; Release_ for Release-row fields
CIQ_Config_Version_A00.rule: v4 L279, then PART D L1140 and the Release fields of PART D P5 (L1043-L1048), which v4 folds into Release rows.

CIQ_Section_A00.rule: v4 L280 and the X2 set 1:1 with the portal CIQP Section (PART C), then PART D L991-L1012. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Components columns use the Components_ prefix (A2 L31).

CIQ_Scope_Run_A00.rule: v4 L281, then PART D L1067. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent).

CIQ_RMES_Safety_A00.rule: v4 L282: one row per case keyed by the case's RMES_Key, a Reference to the case (Result_Case, PART D L1166), header counts (open criteria, open blocking findings), the lock. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Criteria columns use Criteria_, Findings columns use Findings_ (A2 L31).

CIQ_RMES_Regulatory_A00.rule: Same schema as CIQ RMES Safety (v4 L283).

CIQ_Internal_Note_A00.rule: v4 L284, then PART D L1199 (Note_Key, Case_Code, Cycle_No, Linked_Kind, Linked_Key, Note_Text, Note_Author, Note_Dept, Note_At).

CIQ_Audit_Event_A00.rule: v4 L285, then PART D L1092-L1097. Notification and delegation fields included (categories L285).

global_field_rules: Never author Name; never name a field Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project; owner-prefix generic words (A2 L41-L42).
No aggregates of any kind (A2 L32). Gates and holds: plain Number count fields plus blank-safe formulas; a blank count holds and never deadlocks (A2 L33-L34).
A child column never reuses a header field id: prefix it with its table's column_id_prefix, same label (A2 L31).
A field an integration copies has the same type as its portal counterpart (Text, Number, Date, DateTime, Email), never a Select (PART D L733).
Fields beyond v4 only where PART D gives field-level detail that agrees with v4, or where PART A requires them (Number count fields for gates).

hard_rules.rule: Exactly 11 flows (Processes CIQ Case, CIQ Open Point, CIQ Change Request; Forms CIQ Supplier, CIQ Config Version, CIQ Section, CIQ Scope Run, CIQ RMES Safety, CIQ RMES Regulatory, CIQ Internal Note, CIQ Audit Event), 7 embedded child tables, 2 native References (ER01, ER02), 22 lists, 11 custom roles plus Admin and User reused. No portal (CIQP) flow, no 'CIQ ZZ Spike' flow, no CIQ Raw Material / Case Contact / Supplier Contact / Component / Config Release / per-round / Item Register flow. Every flow and list name starts with 'CIQ '.

Step ids, names, kinds, owners and conditions exactly as id_reservations.step_prefix_by_flow, byte-exact with the en-dash U+2013. First and last steps unconditioned. 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review' is one Parallel step with six single-step branches; 'Assess impact' is one Parallel step with five. The six Open Point review steps are sequential conditional steps (exactly one runs), not a parallel block. No explicit Reject/Cancel steps (native reject and send-back, LESSONS 13). Every human step carries an SLA; durations are set by BDF after generate. No step is assigned to CIQ Integration Service after Start.

Field names per id_reservations.field_prefix_by_flow and global_field_rules. Native References only ER01 and ER02 (Result_Case on both RMES Forms); every other link is a Text key (text_key_links) and must NOT become a Reference. Child tables use the reserved child_table_ids and display names; columns use the column_id_prefix. Author the 22 lists with the reserved list ids (no _A00) and items. The reserved step-condition fields (Dept_<D>_Active, OP_To_Supplier, OP_Dept, Impact_<D>, Overall_Approval_Required, Overall_Decision, Hold_For_Open_Items) must exist with values that match the conditions.

Initiators: CIQ Case = CIQ RMM; CIQ Open Point = CIQ RMM and the five Reviewer roles; CIQ Change Request = CIQ Integration Service and CIQ RMM. Name the trade-off that Editable on a Process grants InitiateItems (A2 L56; LESSONS 18). CIQ RMES Safety editable by CIQ Safety Reviewer only, CIQ RMES Regulatory by CIQ Regulatory Reviewer only. Child-table step permissions by table key only. Flow Admin for CIQ Case Admin and no-Delete members are post-generate items. Every role in journey_flow_map must be able to read each flow on its path.

content.summary: CIQ Digital (CIQ_Digital_A00) is the internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire. RMM creates a case for a supplier raw material, receives basic data from the supplier (portal), runs the scope rules and releases sections, obtains the PS-05 completeness confirmation, then the active departments (Regulatory, Safety, QM, Microbiology, Sustainability, optionally RMM) review in parallel, raising open points with the supplier and (Safety, Regulatory) filling one RMES sheet each. Open-items checks and an optional overall approval precede the single PS-11 final release; the end produces a PDF. Supplier change requests are triaged by RMM and assessed in parallel. v4 model: 11 flows (3 Processes, 8 Data Forms) with child tables Contacts, Components, Criteria, Findings, Rounds; 11 custom roles plus Admin/User; the supplier acts only in the separate portal. PART A rules bind: no aggregates (Number count fields + blank-safe formulas), no pages, exact step names, intra-app automations Z1–Z4 only.

personas.name: Raw Material Manager (RMM)
personas.description: Owns the CIQ case end to end and is the single intermediary between the Beiersdorf departments and the supplier. Creates the case, holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and every check, runs scope check, triages change requests, maintains suppliers and contacts, and owns the optional RMM review branch (off by default).
goals: Create a case with all mandatory material, supplier, contact, owner and due-date data
Release the right scope (one section per Mandatory/Optional section, extend never reduce) and activate the right departments
Move the case through basic data, completeness PS-05, Part 2 review, optional overall approval and the single final release PS-11
Resolve leftovers at the two open-items checks, or override with an audited reason
Triage supplier change requests and refuse attempts after the final release
Cancel a case cleanly so no supplier task is left open; complete manually with a reason when needed
Keep supplier companies and their contacts (portal user ids) correct
pain_points: Kissflow has no field-change trigger, so supplier answer changes must arrive as change notices
Nobody may write the case during Part 2, so contact changes need their own open point
Native aggregates are unreliable, so gates depend on count fields written by the acting person
